title: Calibration-First Cross-Cohort Multimodal Temporal Learning for Transferable Asthma-Risk Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2609.35795v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Asthma deterioration forecasting must remain reli- able when patient populations, sensor ecosystems, and available modalities change across cohorts. Existing models commonly optimize within-cohort discrimination and may produce poorly calibrated probabilities after transfer. We present CALIBRA, a calibration-first multimodal temporal framework for short- horizon risk prediction with incomplete data. Dedicated recurrent encoders process environmental, pulmonary, symptom, medication, wearable, and context streams; a reliability-conditioned gate suppresses stale or absent modalities, while gradient-reversal training discourages avoidable cohort signatures. A shrinkage- based hierarchical logistic layer calibrates probabilities using a patient-disjoint target subset, and split conformal prediction provides abstention-capable prediction sets. translated_title: 校准优先的跨队列多模态时序学习用于可迁移的哮喘风险预测
translated_abstract: 哮喘恶化预测必须在患者人群、传感器生态系统和可用模态跨队列变化的情况下保持可靠性。现有模型通常只优化队列内的判别能力，在迁移后可能产生校准不良的概率。我们提出了CALIBRA，一个校准优先的多模态时序框架，用于在不完整数据下进行短程风险预测。专用的循环编码器分别处理环境、肺功能、症状、用药、可穿戴设备和情境等数据流；可靠性条件门控机制抑制过时或缺失的模态，同时梯度反转训练抑制可避免的队列特征。基于收缩估计的分层逻辑回归层利用患者不相交的目标子集对概率进行校准，分割保形预测则提供可弃权的预测集合。为避免伪造临床证据，我们在一个有据可查的数据集上对完整实现进行了评估（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出CALIBRA框架，以校准优先的策略融合多模态时序数据，通过可靠性门控、梯度反转去队列化、收缩分层校准和保形预测，实现跨队列可迁移且概率校准良好的哮喘风险预测。
en_tdlr: CALIBRA is a calibration-first multimodal temporal framework that combines reliability-conditioned gating, gradient-reversal cohort invariance, shrinkage-based hierarchical calibration, and conformal prediction to enable well-calibrated, transferable asthma-risk forecasting across changing cohorts.
